careers.title: We hire by exception.
careers.intro: Bazar caps senior advisor headcount at twelve. We add operations and junior roles cautiously. Open roles are listed below — if nothing fits, we keep a folder open for senior advisor introductions year-round at
careers.why1Body: You will close more, but slower. Advisors on the book average 12 transactions a year, not 60. Each one matters.
careers.why2Body: Senior advisors take a profit share on their book after year one — not a sliding commission tier. The economics scale with you.
careers.why3Body: KYC, conveyancing, audit, photography, marketing — all in-house. You sell the property; we run the process around it.
